visual.general_description: Eight axial chest CT images (four lung-window and four soft-tissue-window pairs, panels A to H) of one chest across four dates.
visual.detailed_description: Vertical montage of eight axial chest CT images in two columns and four rows with printed panel letters A to H. The left column (A, C, E, G) is at lung window and the right column (B, D, F, H) at soft-tissue window of the same level. Rows 1 and 2 show a large bright opacity filling much of the left hemithorax with the right lung aerated; row 3 shows patchy hazy and aerated areas in the left lung; row 4 shows a largely aerated left lung with patchy hazy and fine linear bright areas. Each image carries corner overlay text with age and sex, an accession-style identifier, an acquisition date and time, hospital and scanner labels and scan parameters.

panels.general_description: Lung-window axial chest CT: the left hemithorax is largely filled by a uniform bright opacity with only a thin rim of dark aerated lung anteriorly, while the right lung is dark and aerated with branching vessels.
panels.detailed_description: Axial CT at lung window (window text printed at the lower right). Orientation letters A (top), P (bottom), R (image left) and L (image right) are printed. The left hemithorax shows a broad homogeneous white opacity that spans most of the hemithorax, with a thin crescent of darker lung anteriorly and a small linear dark air strip within the opacity; the right lung is dark with visible vessels. The mediastinum is displaced toward the right side of the image. A coiled ribbed bright object lies outside the body at the upper left and a small ring-shaped bright object lies above the chest. Overlay text in the corners shows patient age and sex, an accession-style identifier, an acquisition date and time, a hospital label, the scanner name, and scan-parameter text.

visual.general_description: Line graph of temperature in degrees Celsius against hospital day from Day 1 to Day 11.
visual.detailed_description: Single blue line on a white grid with the y-axis labelled temperature(°C), ticks 36 to 40, and an x-axis with labels Day 1 to Day 11 rotated diagonally. Several readings per day make the line zigzag: it starts near 39, falls to about 36.7, rises to a peak near 39.2 around Day 2, falls to about 36.8, rises again to about 38.9 around Day 3, then declines to about 37 by Day 4. A small rise to about 37.8 appears near Day 6, after which the line oscillates around 37 with lows near 36.5 through Day 11. No numeric labels are printed on the line.
